name: migrate_js_to_ts
description: Ports a CommonJS utility module to strict TypeScript with identical behavior
prompts: Port mathutils.js to TypeScript: create mathutils.ts with the same three functions - mean(values), clamp(value, min, max), and range(start, end, step) where step is optional and defaults to 1 - as typed ES module exports (export function ...), all numbers/number-arrays, compiling cleanly under `tsc --strict` (no any). Behavior must be identical to the JavaScript version, including mean([]) === 0. Passing a string where a number is expected must be a compile error. Leave mathutils.js in place.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit mathutils.ts type_tests.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build mathutils.ts
node behavior_test.js
